snapshot.text: Health system run by the Government of National Unity; authorities struggle to deliver basic services after years of armed conflict. Main challenges: rebuilding services and non-communicable disease risk, with 44.6% of adults aged 18–69 having three or more risk factors. Recent: Egypt–Libya health cooperation MoU…

minister.name: Mohammed Al-Ghouj
minister.role: Minister of Health in the Government of National Unity

priorities.title: WHO cooperation framework 2026–2027
priorities.text: A strategic framework agreed by the Ministry and WHO for 2026–2027 aims to strengthen primary healthcare, support clinics and hospitals, and build referral and response systems.

priorities.title: National midwifery and nursing policy
priorities.text: The Ministry has approved the first nationwide framework to regulate and develop midwifery and nursing services.

priorities.title: Maternal and child health with UNICEF
priorities.text: A 2026 joint plan with UNICEF targets maternal and child health services and health sector capacity, signed in December 2025.
